display_long_description:
**3D Air Hockey – Made for VR!** 

Welcome to DISC – a new sport created by ASICS.  
Step into the arena with a fast-paced VR sport that tests your reflexes and rewards creativity. 

**Play FREE today – more updates coming soon!**
[media]
👾 **Singleplayer Campaign** – Take on 10 AI bot levels, each with their own playstyle and challenge.
[media]
🤝 **1v1 Multiplayer** – Jump into instant matchmaking or host private games with friends.
[media]
🥏 **Attack With Skill** – Curve forehands, smash power shots, and unleash corkscrew spins.
[media]
🛡️ **Defend Your Goal** – Block shots like a soccer goalie and sharpen your reflexes every time you play.

🏋️ **Fun VR Workout** – Full-body action that keeps you moving. It’s a fitness experience that doesn’t feel like one.

🚀 **Free to Play, More to Come** – Cosmetics, leaderboards, and new modes are on the way.

📣 **Join the Community** – Connect with players, find matches, and shape the future of DISC: disc.asics.com
